'''Dolso''' was a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], he was visited by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was able to retrieve a stolen [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] from [[House of Thul|House Thul]].
